dog.description_text:
Benoit (born: 12/12/2022), weighs 25 pounds and is a young French Bulldog who knows how to sit, loves to run and play, has fun with his toys and enjoys having a treat. Born with a congenital eye issue, Benoit had to have surgery to remove his right eye when he was just 10 weeks old and he continues to have follow-ups with an ophthalmologist for his left eye, which has limited vision, for life. Benoit also developed a head tilt and the neurologist diagnosed him with Hydrocephalus and prescribed Omeprazole – which is a medication he will have to take for life.

Benoit continues to see a Neurologist every 6 months – his last visit, the Neurologist requested Benoit see a specialty surgeon for further evaluation. Benoit was weaned off steroids, a cat scan and surgery were performed and Benoit is still taking antibiotics and he is doing well.

Benoit is a French Bulldog that will need to be checked by a neurologist and an ophthalmologist for the rest of his life.

We really appreciate that you want to give a shelter animal a home. The Humane Society of New York was founded in 1904. The Vladimir Horowitz/Wanda Toscanini Horowitz Adoption Center is a no-kill shelter. Our on-site clinic and staff of skilled Veterinarians looks after the health and well-being of every animal here. We also have a great adoption matchmaking team who will gladly take your profile and match you or your pet with just the right cat or dog companion. We start the process once you have submitted an application to us.

FOR AN APPLICATION, please visit http://humanesocietyny.org/adoptions/ and download then email your application to hsny.adopt@gmail.com.

Our one and only location is:

306 East 59th Street (between 1st & 2nd Avenue) in Manhattan.

If you'd like to sponsor Benoit, please email amk.hsny@verizon.net. You can give as much or as little as you like. Your donation is tax deductible. Thank you!

For additional information on the Humane Society of New York, please visit: humanesocietyny.org. Thank you!3a:T
